varningar: Yesterday was the worst day of the week and it settles the delivery-ceiling question. The main campaign spent 9 011 kr and returned ROAS 0.93 on 6 purchases. Compare it with 21 September: 5 120 kr, ROAS 3.15, 11 purchases. Nearly double the money for barely half the customers. Three days in a row now at 9 000-11 800 kr per day: 13, 14 and 6 purchases while the days at 3 000-5 000 kr gave 10 to 13

That is why the cut is the right move, and why the LISTICLE recovery matters: it went back into the profitable band within one day of being cut. Expect the same from the main campaign at 6 750 kr, and watch tomorrow for whether Meta actually spends less
